LESSON: ADDING VALUE TO CROP PRODUCE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.3: Adding value to crop produce
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Adding value to crop produce, part of Production Techniques in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why do we add value to crop produce? 2. How can we add value to crop produce?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Adding value to crop produce together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Integrity: Applying laid down procedures when learners ethically processes crop produce to add value.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Food and nutrition security as learners process crop produce for value addition.

Link to other subjects: Learners relate value addition concept to commodity marketing learnt in Pre-technical Studies.
